title: A Comprehensive Dataset of Chemical Reactions Covering Second and Third Row Elements with Million-Scale Quantum Chemical Calculations

license.caveat: Per-record third-party provenance was not independently verified.

access_instructions: Download the listed files from the Zenodo record and verify the hashes below. Raw bytes stay in a private cache outside Git.

files.name: B3LYPD3_TZVP.h5
files.role: B3LYP-D3/TZVP endpoint and TS geometries with species-level E/H/G (no forces)

files.name: B3LYPD3_TZVP_IRC.h5
files.role: IRC paths with coordinates, energies and forces
files.note: size_bytes is the rounded size reported by the Zenodo API (9.948 GB) until the download is verified

files.name: GFN2_xTB.h5
files.role: GFN2-xTB counterpart of the reaction set (lower fidelity)

claim_limits: Identity and hash manifest only; no scientific record is admitted by this file.
Admission status is decided per task by docs/data/reaction_qm_task_funnel.md and the Track-B gates.
